sources: https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/bannack-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MT&parkId=630310 (read in a browser 2026-10-22; site list as captured 2026-10-12 in audit/state_park_fees/mt_sites_2026-10-12.json)

values.note: ReserveAmerica: 'two campgrounds; Vigilante and Road Agent offering a total of 24 campsites, 8 of which are available on a first come, first served basis', plus one wall tent and a hike/bike site (FWP counts 28 sites including the wall tent, the hike/bike site and a group picnic site). Road Agent's 8 sites are mostly 15-18 ft back-ins (one 35 ft, one walk-in); Vigilante's 15 run 25-45 ft back-in, plus pull-throughs of 32 and 60 ft.

sites.source: https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/bannack-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MT&parkId=630310 (description; site list with equipment length and driveway type) + https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/bannack-state-park ('The campground has 28 sites, including a Wall Tent, a hike-in/bike-in campsite, with 4 tent pads, and a group picnic site'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 630310 (every campsite 'Electric Hookup - no', 'Full Hookup - no'), captured 2026-10-12, page re-read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water in the summer season only. Store/gift shop with firewood and ice at the park.

facilities.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/bannack-state-park (Seasons & Hours: 'Potable water Available summer season'; 'Toilets (Vault)') + ReserveAmerica amenities ('Toilet, Pit/Vault', 'Water Drinking', 'Retail, Firewood', 'Retail, Ice'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/stateparks/bannack-state-park (Seasons & Hours: 'Campground Open all year.') + ReserveAmerica ('Status: Open year round.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 16 of the 24 campsites reservable; 8 first-come, first-served. Campsites: 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 3 Month(s) in advance.'

note: MT FWP state park at the Bannack ghost town on Grasshopper Creek, ~25 mi SW of Dillon. Tables, fire rings. --Claude
summary: Confirmed no hookups, vault toilets, reservable on ReserveAmerica with 8 first-come sites, the inherited 3-month window and 1-day cutoff. Changed site count 26 -> 24 (ReserveAmerica; FWP says 28 counting the wall tent, hike/bike and group picnic sites) and max length 45 -> 60 (one 60-ft pull-through; 45 back-in), added pull-throughs, summer-only drinking water and year-round campground season. Fees left as recorded (FWP page gives only the statewide $4-$34 range); 7-night limit not stated (inherited). Note: the loop descriptions it carried were wrong (Road Agent sites are 15-18 ft, not ~25; Vigilante has 15 sites, not 18) and moved, corrected, into sites.note.
